page.overview:
Who is Snake Eyes Robot?

Robot Snake Eyes is a character in the Real American Hero comics from IDW.

Doctor Venom created a Snake Eyes robot, but it had too many memories of Snake Eyes and Kwinn to stay loyal to Doctor Venom or Cobra.
